name: The Thermal Club
cited_for: Reference program — 426 private acres and over five miles of track, with homesites, villas and luxury residences, clubhouse, dining, fitness, spa and resort pools.
note: Operator's own figure. Cross-check found 344 acres reported at the 2012/2014 launch and ~424 acres in 2021, so 426 reflects later expansion rather than a conflict. Primary page could not be fetched directly in this environment (network policy blocked the request); figure confirmed via search index of the operator site.

name: Commercial mortgage rate surveys, 2026
cited_for: Range context ONLY for the assumed permanent coupon: lenders quoting roughly 6.5%–8.0% on commercial mortgages in 2026, with well-qualified borrowers in the low-to-mid 6s and life-company paper spanning roughly 5.2%–8.6%.
note: Used to bound an ASSUMPTION, not to set a rate. The 7.25% coupon in config is a placeholder inside this range, biased upward because a private motorsport club is special-purpose collateral with no agency execution. Replace with a real term sheet before IC.

name: Commercial DSCR requirement surveys, 2026
cited_for: Minimum DSCR commonly required at 1.20x–1.35x depending on property type; roughly 1.25x on multifamily and 1.30x–1.40x on other commercial property types.
note: Context for the principal's confirmed 1.30x floor, which sits at the LOW end of the non-multifamily band. A special-purpose recreational asset would plausibly be quoted higher. Does not set the covenant — the principal did.

name: The Thermal Club — broker listing sheets (Desert Pacific Properties)
cited_for: Current membership terms: standard family membership one-time initiation fee of $400,000 (2026 listings; $250,000 on 2025 listings; $200,000 with $2,400/mo on an earlier one), plus membership dues of $3,200/month and a $450/month per-lot ground maintenance fee. Real-estate purchase is REQUIRED — buyers acquire a lot and must build within five years. Premium track-front lots from $785,000; non-track condo sites from $700,000.
note: REFUTES the working hypothesis that Thermal's dues are ~$7,200. All-in recurring is ~$43,800/yr, 29% ABOVE the model's $34,000. The operator site does not publish fees; broker sheets are the only public carrier. Direct fetch returned HTTP 403 across this environment — figures came via search index. Initiation escalation $175k (2024) to $400k (2026) is the steepest pricing move in the comp set.

name: The Thermal Club — IndyStar/USA Today Network via Yahoo Sports, 'Inside The Thermal Club: What a $5.2 million membership gets you'
cited_for: $175,000 initiation and monthly dues 'well over $2,000' (reported elsewhere as $2,400/mo) as of the Feb 2024 IndyCar test; monthly fee 'has doubled over the last five years'. Members must buy a lot and build within five years, costing roughly $5 million. Club had grown to 210 members, 75 properties and 135 lots sold. Initiation reported to include a 70% refundable deposit on exit.
note: Highest-quality third-party source in the comp set: a named reporter on site, not a marketing page. Supplies the ONLY realized absorption count anywhere in the set (~21 members and ~13.5 lots per year over ten years). The 70%-refundable-deposit claim is the most consequential unresolved item in the income block — if the convention holds, initiation NOI falls from $4.25M to $1.275M/yr and income.initiation_treatment has no switch for it.

name: Monticello Motor Club — Grokipedia
cited_for: Membership tiers: Silver $92,500 initiation / $8,600 annual dues (15 days per season, 8 weekend days); Gold $125,000 initiation / $18,500 annual dues (unlimited, no driving restrictions, garage rental priority). 4.1-mile circuit; 670 acres.
note: SOURCE IS AN AI-GENERATED WIKI, NOT A PRIMARY SOURCE. Monticello's own membership page does not publish pricing. Recorded because $125,000/$18,500 is the HIGHEST published Northeast figure found anywhere and therefore sets the Northeast initiation ceiling used in the findings. Direction corroborated by Robb Report 2018 (source 7). MUST be replaced by a call to the MMC membership office before IC — this is the single highest-value call in the project.

name: Robb Report, 'Your Private Race Track Guide' (2018 vintage)
cited_for: Monticello Motor Club $90,000 initiation / $13,700 annual dues for unlimited days; Gold $115,000 / $17,700; Junior (under 35) $45,000 / $5,000 for eight days. Autobahn Country Club $40,000 initiation / $5,500 per year. Palmer Motorsports Park $22,500 initiation / $2,500 dues for 30-plus days.
note: Vintage CONFIRMED as October 2018 by Monticello's own 2018-10-24 post announcing the feature. Eight-year-old pricing — usable only as an escalation anchor, not as current comps. Monticello top tier $115,000 to $125,000 is ~1.0%/yr; Autobahn $40,000 to $50,000 and $5,500 to $6,600 is ~3.2%/yr and ~2.6%/yr, bracketing the model's 3.0% dues escalator. Secondary aggregators muddle the Palmer and Club Motorsports attributions — flagged, not resolved.

name: Apex Motor Club (Maricopa, AZ) — RACER and InMaricopa
cited_for: Gold membership $70,000 initiation / $8,000 annual dues; Platinum $90,000 / $15,000 with as many as 275 days of unlimited track time. Membership capped at 425. 280 acres, 2.27-mile circuit, opened 2018. Garage condos from $430,000 for 1,250 SF (= $344/SF derived), optional 625 SF mezzanine +$25,000; ~264 total for-sale and for-lease garages 625–1,250 SF; Phase 2 adds 48 units across four buildings and 'prices will go up'.
note: The 275-day figure is an OPERATOR MARKETING CLAIM repeated by trade press, not an audited operating calendar — and it is the figure the model's AZ season_days leans on. $344/SF is DERIVED ($430,000/1,250 SF) and is one of only two operating new-build track garage-condo price points in the set. A conflicting account (Rose Law Group, 2021) gives a $50,000/$5,000 to $175,000/$22,500 band; I would underwrite to the tier-specific Gold/Platinum pair.

name: M1 Concourse (Pontiac, MI) — Car Collectors Club and OnlyGarageCondos
cited_for: Motorsports Club: $20,000 one-time initiation, $3,750 annual dues (also reported at $3,950 and $4,950 in other vintages), 6–7 hours per week of track time. 87 acres, 1.5-mile circuit, opened 2016; site 'cost just over $40 million to develop'. Garage condos: 2016 offering $105,000 for 500 SF (= $210/SF); grown to 175+ units of 500–13,000 SF; first 80 units built and sold for ~$20M. CURRENT market: luxury trackside suites at $600/SF, against $110/SF for heated units in Benzonia MI.
note: $210/SF offering to ~$600/SF current is ~2.9x over ten years — the strongest single data point FOR the for-sale thesis in the set, but it is a BUYER's hold return, not a merchant-build margin. The developer captured $210/SF. Do not let $600 migrate into for_sale.garage_condos.sale_price_psf. Realized absorption ~17.5 units/yr against the model's assumed 23/yr.

name: The Concours Club (Opa-locka, Miami) — TopSpeed and Fortune
cited_for: Standard membership $150,000 initiation / $35,000 annual dues, cap 200; 40 founding members at $350,000 one-time with NO annual dues; 150 'legacy' memberships at $125,000 plus unpublished dues. 75-acre campus, 2.0-mile Alan Wilson circuit, 11 corners, opened 2021. Auto Lofts limited to 41 units. Over 200 people on the waiting list.
note: THE ONLY comp supporting the model's $150,000/$34,000 pair — and it is a 75-acre invitation-only airport-adjacent Miami club with a 200+ waitlist, not a 210-day Northeast circuit. At 200 members on 2.0 miles it runs 100 members/track mile and $3.50M of dues per track mile, the highest in the set. The zero-dues $350,000 founding tier is the cleanest example anywhere of trading recurring revenue for upfront capital. Conflicting account puts the non-founding 100 at $375,000 + $35,000/yr; I would underwrite to $150,000/$35,000.

name: Autobahn Country Club (Joliet, IL) — Car Collectors Club
cited_for: Full Membership $50,000 initiation / $6,600 annual dues — every facility and track, right to build on-site condos and secure paddock garages, unlimited track time April through October. Social/Karting membership $5,700 per year. 350 acres; 3.56-mile track splitting into 2.1-mile and 1.5-mile circuits; opened 2005. Garage condos combine 2,000 SF living space with a 2,250 SF climate-controlled garage; trackside lots available for custom builds — UNIT PRICING NOT PUBLISHED.
note: 'April through October' yields ~214 facility days DERIVED, not published — the closest thing to a Midwest/Northeast season benchmark and it brackets the model's 210-day baseline from above. Escalation from Robb Report 2018 ($40,000/$5,500) is +25% initiation and +20% dues over seven years. Garage condo unit pricing is the gap; a Will County Recorder plat search would close it.

name: Atlanta Motorsports Park (Dawsonville, GA) — Urbanize Atlanta and Atlanta Magazine
cited_for: Trackside condos priced from $225,000 for 640 SF shells (= $352/SF derived), units 640–1,280 SF and combinable, two-story with ~30 ft ceilings. All but eight of the 45 condos in phases 1–2 spoken for; phases 1, 2 and 3 subsequently sold out; $8M of condos sold in two months. 2.0-mile Hermann Tilke circuit, opened 2012; 212 private garages reported waitlisted. Main Circuit membership initiation from $12,500, karting from $3,500 — DUES NOT PUBLISHED. Motor Club Circuit Villas broke ground 2025, pricing not published.
note: $352/SF is DERIVED and these are SHELL units — buyer finishes the interior, so it is NOT comparable to a finished-product $530/SF. Together with Apex's $344/SF this establishes that operating new-build track garage condos price at roughly the model's ASSUMED HARD COST of $350/SF. The fastest absorption in the set, but on a $225,000 unit — velocity at $225,000 does not underwrite velocity at the model's $954,000 average unit. Acreage and dues are the missing figures.

name: New Jersey Motorsports Park (Millville, NJ) — operator page and Roadracing World
cited_for: 500+ acres; Thunderbolt (2.25 mi) and Lightning (1.9 mi) circuits; opened 2008. Drivers Club is DUES-ONLY at ~$20,000/yr for 35+ track days with no disclosed initiation (a Black Friday promotion offered 50% off at $10,000). Exotic Car Garages: units 1,000–3,000 SF; pre-construction pricing from $125/SF with a $62,500 base (HISTORIC). Programme has run through NINE phases in ~15 years; Phase III sold out and further phases followed; Phases VIII and IX broke ground spring 2024 as two 10,500 SF buildings of seven 1,500 SF units each.
note: THE CRITICAL ABSORPTION COMP. Closest structural analogue available: a 500+ acre Northeast facility with an operating for-sale garage programme in a comparable tax and entitlement environment. Fourteen units across two phases fifteen years into the programme is ~10–15 units/yr, against the model's assumed 23/yr. Current Phase VIII/IX pricing is NOT PUBLISHED — operator directs buyers to (856) 327-7248. The $125/SF is historic and must not be used as a current comp.

name: Club Motorsports (Tamworth, NH) — Laconia Daily Sun and operator membership page
cited_for: 2.5-mile road course, 15 turns, 250+ feet of elevation change; opened 2018 with nearly 300 members entering its first summer. Bronze $15,000 initiation / $1,500 annual dues for 10 course days; Silver reported at $25,000 / $2,500; Platinum limited to the first 50 paid memberships. Road-course days do not accrue year to year. Trackside condos PLANNED with additional plots on the mountain — nothing built or priced publicly. Open to members 150 days a year.
note: NORTHEAST SEASON EVIDENCE: 150 days is the ONLY published facility-day figure for a Northeast club and is 29% below the model's 210-day baseline. Tamworth is colder than Long Island so 150 is a floor, not a read-through — but 150 is published and 210 is not. Also the clearest Northeast merchant-build warning in the set: a club that opened in 2018 has still not delivered a priced for-sale garage product. Current rate card exists at clubmotorsports.com/_pdfs/ClubMembershipPricing.pdf but would not load (HTTP 403).

name: Lime Rock Drivers Club (Lakeville, CT) — Gear Patrol
cited_for: Drivers Club $16,500 initiation / $3,630+ annual dues for up to 60 days of track time annually on the 1.5-mile circuit; reciprocals with Thompson Speedway and Palmer Motorsports Park.
note: CONFLICT: an older account reports a $55,000 membership with $3,600 dues. I would underwrite to $16,500/$3,630 as the more recent figure and because $55,000 is inconsistent with a 1.5-mile club-day product. The conflict is itself the finding — Lime Rock repriced DOWN, the only observed downward initiation move in the comp set. At 22.0% its dues-to-initiation ratio is one of only two in the set at or above the model's 22.7%.

name: Spring Mountain Motor Resort (Pahrump, NV) — The Speed Journal
cited_for: Charter membership: $60,000 one-time fee plus $6,000 annual, with the initiation since raised to $75,000 (last hike reported 2021). 'Over 9 miles of road course with more than 50 available configurations.' 80 lots for private condos starting at $350,000.
note: The '9 miles' is an operator claim aggregating every layout, NOT a single circuit length — do not use it in a members-per-track-mile calculation without discounting it. Total acreage NOT PUBLISHED. At 8.0% its dues-to-initiation ratio is the lowest in the set. Charter memberships trade on enthusiast forums at a discount, a soft negative signal on secondary-market membership value.

name: MotorSport Ranch (Cresson, TX) — operator pricing page
cited_for: Regular membership: $4,700 initiation, $150/month dues (= $1,800/yr), $25 half-hour session, optional garage RENTAL $345/month. Executive membership: $12,500 initiation, $100/month dues (= $1,200/yr), $20 half-hour session, garage rental $320/month.
note: The floor of the national comp set and proof that 'private motorsport club' spans two orders of magnitude of price point. Garages are RENTAL — there is no for-sale stack. Note the explicit upfront-for-recurring trade the operator prices: $7,800 of extra initiation buys $600/yr of dues relief plus session discounts, a ~13-year payback that corroborates the model's 12-year expected_tenure_years.

name: Iron Gate Motor Condos (Naperville, IL) — OnlyGarageCondos
cited_for: 185+ units, officially SOLD OUT, expanding with 21 additional units in 2026. Pricing across its history ranged $129,000 to $1,000,000+; realized price per square foot $227 to $386.
note: CORRECTION TO THE BRIEF: Iron Gate Motor Condos is in NAPERVILLE, ILLINOIS, not Vermont, and has NO racetrack. That makes it the most useful CONTROL in the set — it isolates what garage-condo product sells for with the track amenity stripped out. If a Chicago-suburb garage condo with no circuit clears $227–$386/SF, the track premium embedded in the model's $530/SF has to be demonstrated, not assumed.

name: Arizona garage condo market report — OnlyGarageCondos
cited_for: Entry-level units (1,000–1,200 SF) $300,000–$380,000; mid-size (1,200–1,600 SF) $450,000–$650,000; premium (1,800+ SF) $700,000–$1,000,000+. Standard inventory ranges roughly $185 to $450 per square foot; premier Scottsdale resales recently past $630/SF. 36 garage condo developments across 13 Arizona cities, ~2,400+ total units.
note: Market-level context for the $/SF band, used in findings §4 to bracket the model's $530/SF. Note the premium band (1,800+ SF, the model's average unit size) prices at $700,000–$1,000,000+, which straddles the model's $954,000 average unit — the model's unit price is defensible in ARIZONA, which is not where the lead site is.

name: Phoenix industrial sale pricing, Q2 2026 — Colliers Phoenix CRE Brief and CBRE Phoenix Industrial Figures
cited_for: Recorded Phoenix-metro industrial trades: Surprise 453,960 SF at $140.74/SF; infill airport-adjacent Phoenix manufacturing 174,800 SF at $252.57/SF; West Valley distribution 1.2M SF at ~$122.50/SF; Phelan Business Park 26,900 SF at ~$283/SF. Q2 2026 vacancy tightened 70bp to 9.6% on 4.7M SF of net absorption.
note: THE FLEX-SPREAD TEST, matched-submarket. Apex's $344/SF garage condo against Phoenix small-bay infill at $252–$283/SF is a spread of 1.2x–1.4x, NOT 3x. The only way to reach 3x is to compare against bulk distribution at $122–$147/SF, which is not the alternative use for a trackside garage buyer. These are closed TRADES, not askings, which makes this the most reliable flex data point in the file.

name: Long Island / Suffolk County industrial and flex pricing — LoopNet and Realmo listing aggregators
cited_for: Long Island industrial properties for sale averaging ~$509/SF. Suffolk County flex space for sale: 36 listings totalling 235,051 SF at an estimated $63,260,000 market value (= ~$268/SF derived).
note: ASKING-PRICE AVERAGES, mixing product types and sizes — Inferred, NOT trades. Recorded because it produces the sharpest contradiction in the findings: at the lead site's submarket, the model's $530/SF garage condo is 1.04x the local industrial asking average and 1.98x the flex average. There is no 3x spread to harvest on Long Island. MUST be replaced with CoStar 5,000–20,000 SF small-bay SALE comps, trailing 24 months, before this finding is relied upon.

name: Utah Motorsports Campus (Grantsville, UT) — Wikipedia
cited_for: 511-acre facility with a 4.5-mile multi-configuration road course, 0.9-mile karting circuit, 8-acre rock crawl, 7-acre skidpad, 22-acre off-road short course and a rallycross course. Tooele County voted 2015-10-13 to sell the facility (then Miller Motorsports Park) to Mitime Investment and Development Group, a Geely subsidiary, for $20,000,000; Mitime took possession 2015-10-31.
note: Public/mixed, so not a private-club pricing comp — but the best ASSET-VALUE comp in the file. 511 acres WITH a complete 4.5-mile circuit at $39,139/acre all-in, far below replacement cost. Bears directly on model/roadmap.py's finding that acquisition-led growth reaches listing scale in year 12 versus year 22 ground-up: built circuits have traded cheap. A county-records confirmation of the deed and consideration would upgrade this to Verified.

name: Emerald Coast Motor Club (DeFuniak Springs, FL) — operator site and opposition group
cited_for: 751-acre proposed motorsport country club with a 3.25–3.3 mile splittable FIA Grade 2 road course, karting complex, and PLANNED trackside two-story garage condos buildable for overnight stays with kitchens, bathrooms and rooftop terraces. Received unanimous Conditional Land Use approval October 2024. Organized local opposition operates at scrapthetrackindefuniak.org.
note: NO MEMBERSHIP OR CONDO PRICING PUBLISHED — the project is pre-launch. Recorded for two reasons: it is the newest US ground-up programme at this scale and its pricing will become the best available comp once released, and the documented organized opposition is the best live example in the set of the entitlement risk that roadmap.entitlement_months: 33 is trying to price.

name: Motorsports Gateway (Howell, MI) — AOL/Livingston Daily
cited_for: Garage condo pricing starts at just over $515,000. Non-residential memberships cost $7,500 annually with more than $40,000 due up front as part of a one-time initial fee. First phase nearing completion.
note: UNIT SIZE NOT PUBLISHED, so NO price per square foot can be derived — do not infer one. Useful as the newest ground-up US comp carrying both a club and a for-sale garage stack, and as a mid-market dues-to-initiation datum at 18.8%.
